blocks.heading: This Is Our Editorial

items.text: This is our editorial view, not a study result.
One skill the market pays for, one that multiplies it (communication in English, data, a second language, AI use with checking), and one finished piece of work that others can see.
Know who pays, say what you do in two sentences, show proof, follow up, ask for referrals, and learn to hold one honest price conversation.

blocks.heading: Degree Routes By Growth and Sales Layer
blocks.sourceSectionTitle: Degree routes by scalability and sales layer

rows: BTech, BCA or BSc in computing, with a real software or data skill
Skills sell directly as projects, freelance work or a small agency. A degree alone is crowded: most engineers are still below Rs 50,000 a month at three years.
Design, writing and media degrees with a portfolio
A portfolio and an audience sell directly. The degree matters far less than the work shown.
A long exam ladder with several pass stages, but a small practice can grow into advisory work.
BCom, BBA or MBA with a domain skill (sales, analytics, finance)
A general business degree is crowded. It scales when you add one applied skill and consulting or a venture later.
BA or BSc with a skill added (psychology, research, data, teaching)
The broad degree group has the flattest pay curve in the data (1.39 times). A niche practice, workshops or an online programme give it a ceiling.
Core engineering (mechanical, civil, electrical) and diplomas
Salaried roles follow a fixed ladder. Contracting, repair, solar or design services give a business layer.
BTech, BCA or BSc in computing, with a real software or data skill
Employers, or startups and small firms as clients. They trust a deployed project more than a mark sheet. First step: a one-page offer for one problem, with one finished example.
Design, writing and media degrees with a portfolio
Brands, agencies and individual clients. They trust past work and referrals. First step: three samples for one type of client, and a polite follow-up after each pitch.
Employers first, then small business owners. They trust a licence and a referral. First step: a fixed-scope package, such as monthly compliance for one kind of firm.
BCom, BBA or MBA with a domain skill (sales, analytics, finance)
Employers; later clients. First step: explain your value in two sentences and ask three people for a warm introduction.
BA or BSc with a skill added (psychology, research, data, teaching)
Individuals, schools and firms. They trust proof, reviews and referrals. First step: pick one niche and one small paid pilot.
Core engineering (mechanical, civil, electrical) and diplomas
Employers, then local customers and contractors. They trust finished jobs and word of mouth. First step: keep a photo log of completed work and ask each customer for a referral.

blocks.sourceSectionTitle: Which degree grows your salary the fastest?
supporting: Medical: 2.31 times and Rs 19,820 more a month, on a thin sample of 40 to 43 people.
Engineering: 1.68 times and Rs 17,000 more, with 42.9% above Rs 50,000 at three or more years.
Other technical degrees: 1.83 times and Rs 15,000 more.
BA, BSc, BCom and BBA together: 1.39 times and Rs 7,000 more.
A government pay step: about 3% a year within a level. At Level 6 (entry basic Rs 35,400), three increments come to roughly 9% before promotion (our arithmetic, dearness allowance left out).
